desc.en: This Qunoot has been mentioned by Syed bin Taoos in his book Muhaj-ud-Daawaat and by Kaf’ami in Al Balad-ul-Amin, both narrating from Imam Ali Naqi (a)…
desc.rurdu: Yeh Qunoot Syed ibne Taoos ne apni kitaab Muhaj-ud-Daawaat aur Kaf’ami Baladul Amin mein Imam Ali Naqi (a) se riwaayat ki hai…
desc.urdu: یہ قنوت سید ابن طاؤس نے کتاب مهج الدعوات اور کعفمی نے کتاب البلد الأمين امام علی نقیؑ سے روایت کی ہے۔۔۔

trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ مَنَاهِلُ كَرَامَاتِكَ بِجَزِیْلِ عَطِیَّاتِكَ مُتْرَعَۃٌ، وَاَبْوَابُ مُنَاجَاتِكَ لِمَنْ اَمَّكَ مُشْرَعَۃٌ۔ وَعَطُوْفُ لَحَظٰاتِكَ لِمَنْ ضَرَعَ اِلَیْكَ غَیْرُ مُنْقَطِعَۃٍ، وَقَدْ اُلْجِمَ الْحِذَارُ، وَاشْتَدَّ الْاِضْطِرَارُ، وَعَجَزَ عَنِ الْاِصْطِبَارِ اَهْلُ الْاِنْتِظَارِ وَاَنْتَ اللّٰھُمَّ بِالْمَرْصَدِ مِنَ الْمُكَّارِ، وَغَیْرُ مُهْمَلٍ مَّعَ الْاِمْهَالِ، وَاللّٰائِذُ بِكَ آمِنْ، وَالرَّاغِبُ اِلَیْكَ غَانِمٌ، وَالْقَاصِدُ اللّٰھُمَّ لِبَابِكَ سَالِمٌ۔

trans.en: O Allah, Your springs of benevolence and dignity are brimming with Your bounties, and the gates of Your solitary supplications are open for all those who intend You, Your affectionate gazes are continuously aimed upon those who face towards Your courtyard with extreme humility and humbleness while fright and terror has reached its final extent and helplessness has become immense, the anticipators are incapable of further perseverance and You O Allah are in ambush for the schemers, You have not let them loose in spite of Your respite for them, only he who relies upon You relaxes in peace, who desires You is benefitting, who intends Your door, O Allah, is secured.
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: اَللّٰھُمَّ فَعَاجِلْ مَنْ قَدِ امْتَرَّ فِیْ طُغْیَانِهٖ، وَاسْتَمَرَّ عَلٰی جَهَالَتِهٖ لِعُقْبَاهُ فِیْ كُفْرَانِهٖ، وَاَطْمَعَهٗ حِلْمُكَ عَنْهُ فِیْ نَیْلِ اِرَادَتِهٖ، فَهُوَ یِتَسَرَّعُ اِلٰی اَوْلِیَائِكَ بِمَكَارِهِهٖ، وَیُوْاصِلُهُمْ بِقَبَائِحِ مَرَاصِدِهٖ، وَیَقْصُدُهُمْ فِیْ مَظَانِّهِمْ بِاَذِیَّتِهٖ۔

trans.en: O Allah, punish them sooner who have oppressed to the final extent, and have continued his infidelity and ingratitude due to his ignorance towards his fate, Your forbearance has resulted in his lust greed for his motives, therefore they have hastened in committing bad deeds against Your friends and devotees, and place their wicked traps on their ways one after the other, and visit their houses and residences with the intention of harming them.

arabic.text: اَللّٰھُمَّ اكْشِفِ الْعَذَابَ عَنِ الْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ، وَابْعَثْهُ جَهْرَۃً عَلَی الظَّالِمِیْنَ۔ اَللّٰھُمَّ اكْفُفِ الْعَذَابَ عَنِ الْمُسْتَجِیْرِیْنَ، وَاصْبُبْهُ عَلَی الْمُغَیِّرِیْنَ۔ اَللّٰھُمَّ بَادِرْ عُصْبَۃَ الْحَقِّ بِالْعَوْنِ، وَبَادِرْ اَعْوَانَ الظُّلْمِ بَالْقَصْمِ۔ اَللّٰھُمَّ اَسْعِدْنَا بَالشُّكْرِ، وَامْنَحْنَا النَّصْرَ، وَاَعِذْنَا مِنْ سُوْئِ الْبَدَارِ وَالْعَاقِبَۃِ وَالْخَتَرِ۔

trans.en: O Allah, lift Your punishment from the believers, and send it down upon the transgressors. O Allah, keep Your torment away from those who seek refuge in You, and descend it upon the alternators. O Allah, assist the groups of truth in haste, and destruct the supporters of oppression and tyranny immediately. O Allah, make us fortunate with Your gratitude, and make victory our share, and protect us from the hastening evil, and from evil fate and lust.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
